reason: A cross-platform Tauri desktop client that packages and launches the DeepSeek Harness web interface with a bundled Node.js runtime, local persistence, model configuration, and inherited harness features.

summaries.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 封装为支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 的原生桌面客户端。
summaries.en: A cross-platform Tauri desktop client that packages and runs the DeepSeek Harness web interface on Windows, macOS, and Linux.

capabilities: launches a bundled Node.js sidecar process
hosts a local web interface on localhost
reads and persists session, settings, and profile data under ~/.dsh
connects to configured model APIs using user-provided credentials
